info.title: GetReverseOrdersForSeller
info.description: Use this API to get the list of items for a range of reverse orders.

get.description: Use this API to get the list of items for a range of reverse orders.

request_type.description: The order applied by the buyer is: CANCEL;   RETURN;    ONLY_ REFUND

refund_amount.description: refund amount, currency in cent, except VN (for example for SG, 100 equals SGD $1; for VN, 10000 equals VND 10000)

item_unit_price.description: price, currency in cent, except VN (for example for SG, 100 equals SGD $1; for VN, 10000 equals VND 10000)

tracking_number.description: tracking number of return order package

receiver_address.description: receiver address, normally refers to seller address or warehouse address. Not available when customer self-arrange.

default.description: See x-lazada-error-codes for documented error codes and guidance.
